Package com.nexuslink.protocol.rabbitmq

Class AmqpUri

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.rabbitmq.AmqpUri
public final class AmqpUri extends Object
Pure, dependency-free parser for a RabbitMQ / AMQP 0-9-1 connection URI — no amqp-client required, so it is fully offline-testable. It splits and percent-decodes a URI of the shape: 
amqp[s]://[user[:password]@]host[:port][/vhost][?k=v&k2=v2]

Two schemes are recognised: amqp (plaintext, default port 5672) and amqps (TLS, default port 5671). When the host is omitted it defaults to localhost; when the port is omitted it falls back to the scheme default.

The virtual-host rules follow the AMQP URI spec and contain a classic gotcha:

  • an absent path (amqp://host) means the default vhost "/";
  • an empty path (amqp://host/) means the empty-string vhost "";
  • the path is a single segment — a second raw '/' is an error, while an escaped %2f decodes to a literal '/' inside the vhost name.

Userinfo (username, password) and the vhost are percent-decoded as UTF-8. toString() and redacted() both mask the password so it is never printed in the clear. Malformed input throws AmqpUriException.
